name: Divergent Change
description: A class that needs to be modified in different ways for different reasons. When you make changes to a class, you find yourself changing many unrelated methods.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Class
refactoringTechniques.description: Split the class into multiple classes, each handling a single area of responsibility.

refactoringTechniques.name: Move Method
refactoringTechniques.description: Move related methods to their own focused class.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Module or Component
refactoringTechniques.description: Extract cohesive subsystems into separate modules or components.

refactoringTechniques.name: Apply Single Responsibility Principle
refactoringTechniques.description: Ensure each class has only one reason to change.
